props.name: samples
props.description: Traffic in time order, evenly spaced. Five-minute buckets or finer, so the shortest alert window has data.

props.name: target
props.description: The SLO as a fraction: 0.999 is three nines.

props.name: windowStart
props.description: When the SLO window began. Defaults to the first sample.

props.name: alerts
props.description: Alert rules to evaluate. Defaults to the SRE workbook’s four multi-window rules.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Format a timestamp for the axis, tooltip and alert list.
